snippet.title: Starshapes - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try it on itch:
peterbjorn.itch.io/starshapes


The Officail Starshapes Demo Version Trailer is here!

Currently out on itch.io, coming soon to Steam!

Starshapes was made by Peter R. Bjørn, with Music by Hannibal Sigfusson.
